newsitem.title: USA: Coach says deal to raise revenue runs.
newsitem.headline: Coach says deal to raise revenue runs.

text.p: Coach USA Inc said it plans to merge with four companies with combined annual revenues of $90 million. Terms were not disclosed.
The transactions would increase the current revenue run rate of Coach USA to over $350 million, it said.

The companies are Antelope Valley Bus Inc of Lancaster, Calif., International Express Corp of Minneapolis, Minn., Kerrville Bus Company of Kerrville, Texas and Red & Tan Enterprises Inc of Bergenfield, N.J.

"With these transactions, some of the premier leaders in the motorcoach industry join Coach USA," said Coach USA Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Richard H. Kristinik. "Their companies add substantially to our already strong position in Los Angeles, northern New Jersey and Texas. We also added an airport transportation company in Minneapolis."
One of the companies having revenues of $20 million would be accounted for as a pooling-of-interests and the other three businesses having revenues of $70 million would be accounted for as purchases.
Coach USA is the largest provider of motorcoach tour and charter services and one of the largest providers of motorcoach commuter and transit services in the United States.
